text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Rei, having cleared up a request on her own,
returns to the guildhouse with a tired expression on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルドへの依頼を一人で終わらせたレイは、
疲れた様子でギルドハウスへ戻った。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I'm back... Is Hiyori still out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただいま……
ヒヨリはまだ戻ってない？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. 
If you're looking for Hiyori, she just left.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかえりなさい。
さっき出かけたばっかりだよ。
すれ違わなかった？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even see her. Please tell me that
she hasn't gone out to find some more requests, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや。
……
まさかとは思うけど、
また依頼人を探しに行ったんじゃないだろうね──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Heyo! I'm back!
Great news! 
I've found someone who has a request for us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただいまー！　
レイさんユイちゃん、
あたしたちに依頼したいことがあるって人、
見つけてきたよー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: W-welcome back...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お、
おかえりなさい。
ヒヨリちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I knew it.
Oh well. It'd be rude to chase them off, so let's hear them out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やれやれ。
追い返すのもアレだ。
話だけは聞こう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You're the best, Rei! Hey, come on in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと！　
入ってきていいですよ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for troubling you when you're already so busy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
失礼します。
すみません、
お忙しいところを……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. More importantly,
what is it you need from us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
構わないよ。
それでは、
私たちへの依頼内容を
話してもらえるかな？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
There's a rare species of flower that only blooms
during this season. I'd like you to escort me 
to and from the volcano where it's located.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回みなさんに依頼したいのは、
火山へ行って戻ってくるまでの
護衛です。
みなさんは
この時期に火山でしか採れない
希少種の花があるのはご存じですか？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of it before. It stands out for its brilliant red color,
and if gifted to the one you love, it's said to tie you together for life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
噂で聞いたことがあります。
眩しいくらい紅い花で、
それを意中の人に渡すと
想いが通じるって。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. 
I... I want to use it when proposing to the woman I love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は僕、
その「縁結びの花」を恋人に渡して……
プロポーズを……
したいんです。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
A proposal?! I love it!
Hey, Rei. I think we should—
text_block_list.orig_text:
プロポーズ！　
素敵ですね！
……レイちゃん。
あのね、
わたし……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* One day you'll stop to think, Hiyori. As nice as it sounds,
Twinkle Wish isn't some charity foundation. As for you, Yui,
I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't let your emotions get the best of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ヒヨリ。
どうしてそういつも安請け合いをするの？
ギルド運営は慈善事業じゃないんだ。
ユイも、
あっさり情にほだされるのは良くないな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: S-sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごめんなさい……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That said, turning a request like this down wouldn't
be the best idea in terms of our reputation.
So we'll accept it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……とは言え、
こんな依頼を無下に断ったとなれば、
ギルドの信用にも関わってくる。
引き受けよう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Rei...!
text_block_list.orig_text: レイちゃん……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
You have no idea how much this means to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます！
よろしくお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You really are the best, Rei!
Not gonna lie, part of me thought you'd say no. Eheheh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイさん……
ありがとー！
ダメだって言われるかと思っちゃった……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Honestly now...
There's one condition, though. When this is done, 
we all have to take the next day off. Understood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく……
ただし、
これが終わったら翌日は必ず全員が休息をとること。
いい？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Got it! Right troops, off to Mount Verio we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！　
よーし、
みんなでヴェリオ火山に出発だー！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think that was the last one. There's a lot more monsters
around here compared to the areas near town.
Probably thanks to how little people come here in the first place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
今のが最後の一匹か。
この辺りは人もあまり立ち入らないからか、
街の近くよりも魔物が多いな……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Monsters on that level are barely any effort.
More importantly, I should thank you for coming along with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これくらい大したことじゃないよ。
それよりキミのほうこそ、
一緒に来てくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
The flower store person said that we should
be able to find it if we're this high up!
Let's get this wrapped up in a jiffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
花屋さんの話だと、
この高さまで来れば
見つけられるかもしれないって！
みんなで頑張ってみつけようー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: W-woo. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: I'll do everything I can to help!
text_block_list.orig_text: よろしくお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few hours later...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──数時間後。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Still nothing, in spite of our best efforts...
I suppose it's not classified as a rare species for nothing.
choice_data_list: It's too early to give in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなりに探したつもりだけど、
見つからないね……
希少種と呼ばれるだけはあるか……
。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We're almost at the restricted zone...
But yeah, you're right! We're sure to find it if we keep at it!
Let's gooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうすぐ立ち入り禁止区域まで来ちゃうけど……
諦めなかったらきっと見つかるよね！
がんばるぞー！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Look! Look over there!
I... I found it! I really found it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あった。
ありました！！
ほら
これ！　
ここに咲いてますよ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, you're right!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ホントだ……！
おめでとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとうございますっ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it looks like!
Honestly, it's amazing that a flower can even bloom on a volcano!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが縁結びの花……！
火山で花が咲くって
すごいことだよね！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just the idea of a flower being able to grow in a place
like this makes you think about how mysterious life can be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
草木が育つには過酷すぎる環境で
花を咲かせるなんて……
生命の神秘を感じるよ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
...There we go. If all goes well, I'll come back with her to plant
a new seed. That'll give someone else a chance to come in
the hopes of getting their feelings across.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
これでよし。
プロポーズが成功したら、
花から取れる種を
恋人と植えに来ます。
そうすれば次に想いを伝えたい人が
花を探しにくるでしょうから。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That's a good plan, actually.
Anyway. We should leave before more monsters surface.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはいい考えだ。
さあ、
魔物が現れないうちに山を下りよう。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Rei, look!
There's some people coming up this way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイさん見て！
下から誰か登ってくるよ！

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you lot! That's the rare flower that only
blooms here, isn't it?! I know it is!
Would you mind letting us have it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ！　
アンタたち、
もしかしてその手に持ってる花は、
縁結びの花じゃないか！？　
なぁそうだろ？
そいつをオレたちに譲ってくれないか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: U-uhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Umm, is there any specific reason that you want it?
I think you—
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
どうしてこの花が欲しいんですか？
理由を──

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Hiyori, Yui. Take a better look at them. No normal group
would come here decked out with that many weapons. They're
mercenaries. We should distance ourselves from them right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ヒヨリ、
ユイ。
ヤツらの恰好を見て。
火山にあれだけの武装をしてくるなんてただ者じゃない。
恐らく傭兵だ。
話を打ち切ってすぐに距離を取ろう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: R-right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hmm... They don't seem that threatening to me, but okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
怖い人には見えないけど……
分かった！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: We're not looking to give this away, I'm afraid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いけど、
あなたたちに渡すためのものじゃない。
失礼するよ。

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait up! Listen, we're mercenaries. Our reputation will be
in the trash if we don't get our hands on that! If you want money,
then we've got it! So come on, at least hear us out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ頼むよ！　
オレたちは傭兵だ。
こんなことで
失敗したら沽券ってやつが危うくなるんだよ！
金ならある！　
もう少し話し合おうぜ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Not one for giving in, I see. 
Take our client and get him away from here as quickly as possible.
We'll keep them busy for a bit before withdrawing.
choice_data_list: Make sure you catch up, no matter what.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうあっても引き下がらないつもりか……
キミはあの人を連れて、
すぐにここから離れて。
私たちもヤツらの動きを止めたら後を追う。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Thanks. You take care, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
キミも気を付けて！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
We will. Sorry to keep relying on you.
But also, thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってる。
いつも頼ってばかりですまない。
……ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Now go! We'll handle things here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ行って！　
ここは私たちが！

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text: H-hey, hold up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
おい！　
待てよ兄ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Forgive me!
text_block_list.orig_text: ごめんなさいっ！

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text: Whoa, my eyes! It's too bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおっ！　
眩しい！　
目が開けらんねぇ……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Now's our chance! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のうちだね！　
行こうレイさん、
ユイちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Phew... We should be able to escape at this rate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままなら逃げ切れそうだね……
良かった。

text_block_list.name: Mercenary２
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, you lot!
Did another group come up this way? They were with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……？　
なぁアンタら！
この先でオレらの仲間を見なかったか？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Shoot! There was more than one unit!
text_block_list.orig_text: 別働隊がいたのか……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: U-uhh... Nope. Never seen another person in my life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えーっと……
いませんでしたよ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Hiyori!
You couldn't have made that any more obvious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃん……
それじゃあバレバレだよ……！

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text: Come on, wait up! Hey, you lot finally caught up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ待てって！　
あれ、
テメェらやっと追いついたのかよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, now we're surrounded!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、
挟みうちにされちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, this is all my fault.
I never should have made the request in the first place.
We might as well just hand it over to the—
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません……
私が依頼したばかりに……
こうなったら
素直に花を渡して──

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Just what do you think you're doing?!
You're supposed to negotiate with them, not provoke them!
Please accept my apologies on their beha—
text_block_list.orig_text:
──待ちなさい、
お前たち！
この人たちを警戒させてどうするの！
ごめんなさい。
ウチの者がご迷惑を──

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: ...Why are [i]you[/i] here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どうして
キミがここに？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Darling?! Wait, that flower...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アナタ……！　
それに、
その花……！

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for real? Didn't think you were all friends with our Miss!
You should have just said so! Would have made life easier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでぇ、
お嬢のお知り合いだったんですかい！
それならそうと言ってくれりゃあ良かったのに！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so sorry!
The truth is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当にごめんなさい！
実は……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Your father is the leader of these mercenaries...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミが、
この人たちのいる傭兵団の、
団長の娘……？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I always wanted to tell you, but... I just wasn't sure if you would
accept me in spite of it. That thought had me paralyzed with fear.
That's why I decided to tell you after gifting you that flower...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずっと言おうと思ってたの……
でも
あなたが受け入れてくれるか分からなくて、
怖かった。
だから、
縁結びの花を渡して
打ち明けようって……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So that's what was going on! 
I was wondering why mercenaries would want it,
but now it all makes sense!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったんだ！　
傭兵さんがどうして
縁結びの花を欲しがるのかなって思ってたけど、
そういうことだったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text:
She tried to come here all on her own, so we chased after her in a
panic! We wanted to buy the flower off of you after noticing that
you had it, but then you all cut and run! Talk about a rough day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレらはお嬢が一人で火山に行くなんて言い出すから
心配でついてきたんだよ！　
そしたら花はアンタらに取られちまうし、
売ってもらおうと思ったら逃げられちまうし散々だぜ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
We really can't apologize enough. 
We had the completely wrong idea about you all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきはすみませんでした。
わたしたち、
つい誤解しちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I'm ashamed of myself...
text_block_list.orig_text: 面目ない……

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! 
All that's left to do now is watch over those two from afar.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいってことよ！　
……後のなりゆきは
あの二人次第だな。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't surprised.
But my feelings for you haven't changed in the slightest.
So please, take this flower!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……正直、
今はまだ戸惑ってることもあるけど、
キミへの気持ちに変わりはない。
どうか、
この花を受け取って欲しい！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: ...With pleasure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
はい！　
喜んで！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh, excellent! Things worked out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった……！　
二人の想いが通じ合ったんですね！

text_block_list.name: Mercenary２
text_block_list.text:
It happened! It finally happened!
Our little Miss has come so far!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおおおおっ！　
あのお嬢がついに……！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Hip hip hooray!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おめでとうございます！　
ばんざーい！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Monsters! They must have reacted to all the noise!
choice_data_list: Let's get these two to safety first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物め、
声に反応して集まってきたのか……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Um... Do you mind if we ask for your help, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
傭兵さんたちも
手伝ってもらえませんか？

text_block_list.name: Mercenary
text_block_list.text: Not a problem! We'll do anything to help the Miss out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうよ！　
お嬢を助けるためなら喜んで手を貸すぜ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Nothing better than helping each other out!
Right-o! Time to wipe out some monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ったときはお互いさまさま、
だよね！
よぉーし、
どんどんやっつけるぞぉー！　
とりゃー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, the group succeeds in fending off
the onslaught of monsters. A few days later, a letter from
their client arrives at Twinkle Wish's guildhouse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に魔物たちを倒したヒヨリたち。
数日後、彼女たちの元へ男性から手紙が届く。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
\"I want to ensure the best possible future for us, so I've decided
to have her father train me up so I can succeed his position as
leader at some point. Thank you once again for all your help.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
「……これからは
二人で幸せになるため、
彼女の父親に鍛えられながら、
未来の傭兵団の団長を目指します。
今回は本当にありがとうございました」

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear that they're both happy.
I bet none of us expected things to turn out like this
after we first came across those mercenaries.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも幸せそうで良かった。
傭兵さんたちと会った時は
どうなるかと思ったけど……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I'm still in shock over it all.
That's the sort of mistake Hiyori would make...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
まさかヒヨリみたいな勘違いをするなんて……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up!
Aren't you happy to be more like your best bud Hiyori?
text_block_list.orig_text:
元気出してレイさん！　
あたしと一緒じゃ嬉しくない？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: There's a gross misunderstanding going on right now.
text_block_list.orig_text: そういう問題じゃないんだよ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...
Oh, sorry. I couldn't help myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふふっ。
ごめんなさい。
我慢出来なくて……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Don't laugh!
I regret it enough as it is already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願いだから笑わないでー！
ちゃんと反省してるからー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As laughter filled the guildhouse, the three of them could feel
that their time spent taking on requests together had
helped them grow much closer to one another than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ヒヨリたちは笑いながら、
ギルドへの依頼を幾つもこなす中で、
自分たちの絆がより深まってきたのを実感した。
